newsitem.title: USA: Polk County, Iowa, voters reject sales tax again.
newsitem.headline: Polk County, Iowa, voters reject sales tax again.

text.p: Voters in Polk County, Iowa have once again rejected a one percent local option sales tax.
Unofficial results from Tuesday's election showed 26,493 votes against the tax and 19,937 in favor of the tax, according to the county election office.
The defeat marked the third time voters have turned down the tax over the last 10 years, election officials said.

Revenues from the tax were to be used for property tax relief, school capital projects and other government services. The Des Moines Independent School District reportedly was counting on sales tax revenues to back $89 million of bonds it wants to sell to rehabilitate schools.
